answer: Make each epoch's reward claim require a fresh memory-hard puzzle that takes a full minute of dedicated RAM to solve. One honest agent barely notices, but an operator running a thousand fake agents must rent a thousand machines, so cost climbs like a terrace, one step per identity. Picture every account as a vertex that has to pay its own way in; even at the zenith of a price rally, farming rewards with clones stops paying once the hardware bill exceeds the payout.
